sentence: This project studies how close relationships, including romantic relationships, are linked to the health and adjustment of adolescents.
This project builds tools that cause mutations in gene regulatory elements and catalogs their effects to predict how variants affect human health and disease.
This project studies how delivering interleukin-12 inside tumors can help chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapies work against solid tumors.
This project builds a system of human cells modeling the reflex arc to study how Alzheimer's disease affects the peripheral nervous system.
This project tries to prevent Lyme disease by giving white-footed mice heritable immunity, since these mice infect ticks.
This project builds an AI tool that uses mammographic and clinical data over time to predict near-term breast cancer development in women.
This project studies how hemodynamics and thrombus formation relate to rupture of abdominal aortic aneurysms, using computational modeling and machine learning.
This project studies whether delirium after surgery reveals brain problems that were already there or is caused by an injury to the brain.
This project combines genetic, lifestyle, dietary and methylation data to find veterans at highest risk of Type 2 Diabetes and understand basic mechanisms.
This project tries to find out how a germline variant in a gene involved in glial development affects glioma susceptibility and growth.
This project designs hepatitis C virus vaccine antigens and nanoparticles and tests them in mice and rhesus macaques.
This project studies how social isolation stress during adolescence causes microglial pruning of astrocytes and affects neural circuits that govern social behavior.
This project studies how two signaling pathways work together to make cardiomyocytes multiply in adult mice and in human stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes.
This project builds multiplex reporter systems to map how mouse bile acids interact with nuclear receptors.
This project tries to find out whether neuropeptides control the pace of aging and lifespan.
This project develops statistical methods to understand how the microbiome and host genetics interact in childhood asthma.
This project builds tools based on adeno-associated virus that make chimeric antigen receptor T cells inside the body to target HIV infected cells.
This project tests a vaccine that presents the whole HIV spike in monkeys to trigger antibodies against two key regions of the spikes.
This project builds data science methods to analyze health drivers in national geospatial datasets and public health records.
This project develops methods to measure and simulate biomolecular structures and corrects flaws in statistical methods used in biological and medical research.
